verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ عَلَى «ٱلْحَمَامَةِ ٱلْبَكْمَاءِ بَيْنَ ٱلْغُرَبَاءِ». مُذَهَّبَةٌ لِدَاوُدَ عِنْدَمَا أَخَذَهُ ٱلْفِلِسْطِينِيُّونَ فِي جَتَّ. اِرْحَمْنِي يَا ٱللهُ لِأَنَّ ٱلْإِنْسَانَ يَتَهَمَّمُنِي، وَٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ مُحَارِبًا يُضَايِقُنِي.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Jonath-elem-rechokim, Michtam of David, when the Philistines took him in Gath. Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Silent Dove in Distant Lands.” A poem by David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.

verses.ar: تَهَمَّمَنِي أَعْدَائِي ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ، لِأَنَّ كَثِيرِينَ يُقَاوِمُونَنِي بِكِبْرِيَاءَ.
verses.kjv: Mine enemies would daily swallow [me] up: for [they be] many that fight against me, O thou most High.
verses.web: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.

verses.ar: فِي يَوْمِ خَوْفِي، أَنَا عَلَيْكَ أَتَّكِلُ.
verses.kjv: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
verses.web: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

verses.ar: ٱللهُ أَفْتَخِرُ بِكَلَامِهِ. عَلَى ٱللهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ فَلَا أَخَافُ. مَاذَا يَصْنَعُهُ بِي ٱلْبَشَرُ؟
verses.kjv: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
verses.web: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

verses.ar: ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ يُحَرِّفُونَ كَلَامِي. عَلَيَّ كُلُّ أَفْكَارِهِمْ بِٱلشَّرِّ.
verses.kjv: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts [are] against me for evil.
verses.web: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.

verses.ar: يَجْتَمِعُونَ، يَخْتَفُونَ، يُلَاحِظُونَ خُطُواتِي عِنْدَمَا تَرَصَّدُوا نَفْسِي.
verses.kjv: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.
verses.web: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.

verses.ar: عَلَى إِثْمِهِمْ جَازِهِمْ. بِغَضَبٍ أَخْضِعِٱلشُّعُوبَ يَا ٱللهُ.
verses.kjv: Shall they escape by iniquity? in [thine] anger cast down the people, O God.
verses.web: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.

verses.ar: تَيَهَانِي رَاقَبْتَ. ٱجْعَلْ أَنْتَ دُمُوعِي فِي زِقِّكَ. أَمَا هِيَ فِي سِفْرِكَ؟
verses.kjv: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: [are they] not in thy book?
verses.web: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?

verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ تَرْتَدُّ أَعْدَائِي إِلَى ٱلْوَرَاءِ فِي يَوْمٍ أَدْعُوكَ فِيهِ. هَذَا قَدْ عَلِمْتُهُ لِأَنَّ ٱللهَ لِي.
verses.kjv: When I cry [unto thee], then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God [is] for me.
verses.web: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.

verses.ar: ٱللهُ أَفْتَخِرُ بِكَلَامِهِ. ٱلرَّبُّ أَفْتَخِرُ بِكَلَامِهِ.
verses.kjv: In God will I praise [his] word: in the LORD will I praise [his] word.
verses.web: In God, I will praise his word. In Yahweh, I will praise his word.

verses.ar: عَلَى ٱللهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ فَلَا أَخَافُ. مَاذَا يَصْنَعُهُ بِي ٱلْإِنْسَانُ؟
verses.kjv: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.
verses.web: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

verses.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ، عَلَيَّ نُذُورُكَ. أُوفِي ذَبَائِحَ شُكْرٍ لَكَ.
verses.kjv: Thy vows [are] upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.
verses.web: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ نَجَّيْتَ نَفْسِي مِنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ. نَعَمْ، وَرِجْلَيَّ مِنَ ٱلزَّلَقِ، لِكَيْ أَسِيرَ قُدَّامَ ٱللهِ فِي نُورِ ٱلْأَحْيَاءِ.
verses.kjv: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: [wilt] not [thou deliver] my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?
verses.web: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.
